2023_025_jun_2023_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's purchasing-card (PCARD) report for June 2023, carried on the Board of Education agenda of August 15, 2023 and printed 8/10/2023, lists every card transaction journalized as JUNE PCARD EXP with its transaction date, vendor, budget unit, account code, transaction amount and credit. Charges range from a $1.00 TEACHERSPAYT purchase to a $10,300.00 payment to YMCA CAMP CO on 6/5/2023, and cover vendors from Amazon, Kroger, Staples and Uline to The Henry Ford, Troy Historical, Scholastic and Pioneer Valley. The report closes with a printed Subtotal of 230,022.77 in transaction amounts and 2,484.09 in credits, and Total Expenses of 227,538.68.
